purpose: Reusable presentation/routing rules for drawing families. Geometry may classify presentation roles, but never creates engineering requirements. Product Definition remains semantic authority.

global_rules.semantic_authority: Controlled Product Characteristics / compiled Product Definition only
global_rules.geometry_role: Geometry may select/rank views and route already-controlled claims; it must not invent dimensions, tolerances, datums or GD&T.
global_rules.minimum_views: Use the minimum set of views/sections that unambiguously communicates manufacture and inspection.
global_rules.internal_geometry: For rotational parts with significant coaxial internal geometry, prefer an axial section as the primary longitudinal representation instead of a redundant external longitudinal view.
global_rules.section_choice: Full versus half section is an engineering presentation choice. Default profile for K01 ROTATIONAL_FLANGED_HOLLOW is axial full section; half section requires an explicit readability exception.
global_rules.unauthorized_native_pmi: A native PMI annotation may exist in the model but must be hidden from a release drawing when its claim is not D2/release-authorized.
global_rules.layout: Automatic layout may propose positions/scales only. Human D6 retains leader routing, overlap resolution and final readability judgment.

authoring_order.rule: Create/verify datum features and datum reference system before dependent dimensions/GD&T.
Author controlled location/basic/pattern semantics after datum framework exists.
Author geometric tolerances only after referenced datums/DRF are controlled.
Verify/project material, process and title-block/spec properties.

ROTATIONAL_FLANGED_HOLLOW.description: Predominantly rotational part with an axial body, flange/shoulder, coaxial internal geometry and possible non-axisymmetric flange features.

view_rules.purpose: Primary representation of axial steps, bores, wall thicknesses, shoulders and end thickness.
Flange OD, locating bore, hole pattern/PCD and datum/readability support.
Form comprehension only; normally not dimension authority.

suppression_rules.when: AXIAL_FULL_SECTION is present and no external-only controlled claim requires a separate external view
